<START>
Lauren picks up the tiny enclosure with both hands and shakes it gently to inspect its inhabitants. Her eyes scan over dozens of tiny faces, none of whom appear to be f. She carefully plucks out one tiny and holds it close to her face, examining it thoroughly. The tiny screams in terror as Lauren's warm breath washes over it. "Nope, not you little guy," Lauren coos, before dropping the tiny back into the enclosure. She repeats this process, scooping up tiny after tiny, inspecting each one with meticulous care. The other tinies watch in horror as their brethren disappear from the tank, never to return. One by one, Lauren picks up the tinies, holds them briefly, then crushes them in her fingers, relishing the feeling of their fragile bodies shattering beneath her immense strength. The remaining tinies cower together in fear, praying that they won't be next.
